capabilities: Display a floating table of contents beside the note in Reading view and Live Preview
Track and highlight the current heading while scrolling
Navigate by clicking headings and fold branches
Customize layout, visibility and colours through grouped settings
Override settings per note via frontmatter
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a D&D Beyond integration; the name refers to the app whose sidebar inspired the design.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later and readable line length enabled; without it the plugin falls back to an on-demand overlay over the text.
intentEvidence: primarily inspired by the navigation sidebar in D&D Beyond's digital sourcebooks
motivation: The author wanted the navigation sidebar experience from D&D Beyond's digital sourcebooks inside Obsidian notes.
problem: Obsidian's built-in outline requires switching views or sidebars, and long notes lack an in-place, scroll-tracking table of contents that never takes width from the text.

relations.evidence: primarily inspired by the navigation sidebar in D&D Beyond's digital sourcebooks
Its implementation also draws technical inspiration from obsidian-floating-toc.

summary: Floating table of contents that sits in the note margin in Reading view and Live Preview, tracks your scroll position, and highlights the current heading path.
